# Bettercontact

Smart Waterfall Email & Phone Finder for contact enrichment and lead generation

Category: Sales & CRM. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bettercontact/.

## Actions

- **Check Credits Balance** (read-only): Check the remaining credits balance for a BetterContact account.
- **Create Lead Finder Search**: Create a new Lead Finder search to discover leads based on company and people criteria.
- **Enrich Leads**: Create a lead enrichment request for work emails and direct phone numbers.
- **Get Enrichment Results** (read-only): Retrieve enrichment results for a specific request ID.
- **Get Lead Finder Results** (read-only): Retrieve results from a submitted Lead Finder search.
